Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Team Lead Website to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🔎 Recruitment Process

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

 
 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

data.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

  • Bilingual Skills: Fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • People-First Energy: You bring genuine warmth, high empathy, and enthusiasm to every interaction, turning routine support into remarkable member experiences.

  • Phone-First Instinct: You default to picking up the phone whenever a complex issue calls for a personal touch.

  • Rigorous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for misquotes, incorrect details, or operational errors.

Nice to have

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Prior background in healthtech, fintech, or another high-compliance consumer space where accuracy is critical.

  • Startup Mindset: Thrives in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution, and clear communication.

  • Modern Tooling: Practical experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and boost support efficiency.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

data.title: Développeur Full Stack JS
data.description:
Demain, notre console recevra des milliards de requêtes. Votre mission : faire en sorte qu’elle tienne, et qu’elle reste rapide. Arkane Cloud crée un poste de Développeur Full Stack, à 80 % back-end, pour bâtir une plateforme taillée pour la charge.

 

Notre société

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure composée de centaines de GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique.

  • Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler

  • Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

 

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre console est le point d’entrée de nos clients : c’est là qu’ils déploient et pilotent leurs ressources GPU. Avec l’essor de l’IA, elle va devoir absorber une très grande quantité de requêtes. Nous créons ce poste pour la rendre robuste face aux pics de charge, développer les API qui la font tourner et installer les bonnes pratiques qui permettront à l’équipe de grandir. Votre temps se partage à 80 % sur le back-end et 20 % sur le front-end.

 

Vos missions

• Tenir les pics de charge : une architecture qui absorbe le trafic sans ralentir.

• Développer nos API en Node.js : performantes, sécurisées, documentées.

• Installer les bonnes pratiques : revues de code, tests automatisés, monitoring.

• Optimiser la base de données PostgreSQL.

• Faire évoluer l’interface de la console en React.js (environ 20 % du temps).

 

Vos 6 premiers mois

1er mois : Prise en main de la console et de son architecture, premier audit de performance, premières mises en production.

3 mois : Tests de charge en place, premiers points de blocage corrigés, bonnes pratiques formalisées.

6 mois : Console capable d’absorber n'importe quelle montée en charge, monitoring et alertes opérationnels.

 

Votre expérience

• 5 ans ou plus en développement, avec une dominante back-end.

• Une expérience sur une plateforme grand public ou à fort trafic.

Vos expertises

• Node.js : conception d’API robustes et performantes.

• React.js : à l’aise pour faire évoluer une interface existante.

• Montée en charge : cache, files d’attente, tests de charge, scalabilité.

Un vrai plus :

Playwright, Grafana, connaissance du cloud ou des infrastructures GPU.

Votre façon de travailler : rigoureux sur la qualité, pragmatique, à l’aise pour partager vos pratiques avec l’équipe.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Un vrai défi technique : S'assurer de la robuste de la plateforme lors des montées en charge

• Un impact direct : Vos choix d’architecture façonnent la plateforme.

• Des standards à poser : c’est vous qui fixez le niveau d’exigence de l’équipe.

• Au cœur de l’IA : vos API pilotent une infrastructure GPU dédiée à l’IA.

 

Package et avantages

• Télétravail 3 jours par semaine, présence au bureau de Lyon le mercredi et le jeudi

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

• Choix du matériel (PC ou Mac) & BSPCE

 

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

 

Compensation: €45K – €65K

data.title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (H/F), Paris
data.description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Paris).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office option
  • Flexible working hours
  • Fitness subsidy
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies

  • 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries

This is a vacancy for a hybrid role based at our coworking office in Paris (9th arrondissement, Opéra). We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender identity. We're a small, fast-moving French team backed by a German HQ. We need someone genuinely entrepreneurial who thrives on ownership rather than process, and who is both commercially sharp and technically curious – a strong communicator able to translate technical value into business outcomes.

Ready to make an impact?

  • Up to 20 days of remote work per year from any EU country
  • Opportunity to work flexibly from home

If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply! 

Lobster is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where empathy and respect guide our interactions.

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
data.description:
About H:

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

 

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

 

What you'd be doing

  • Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

  • Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

  • Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

  • Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

  • Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

  • Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

 

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

 

Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

 

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

data.title: Automation Lead
data.description:
About us, and our mission

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer.

Key qualifications

Must-have

  • Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.

  • Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice-to-have

  • You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience.

  • Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work.

  • A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace.

  • Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software.

  • Experience hiring and leading an automation team.

What we offer

  • You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver.

  • Short decision lines and fast execution.

  • An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes

  2. Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process

  3. Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director

  4. Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk.

  5. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes

  6. Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered

  7. Founder conversation — 45 minutes

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

data.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an international energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manage the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation.

 

We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

  • Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client.

  • Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity.  You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints.   

  • Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients.

Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

  • Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner.

  • International mindset: International experience is a plus.

  • Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and compute topics, and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

  • Ethical Awareness: Ability to promote an ethical and responsible culture.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

data.title: Perception and Fusion Engineer
data.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

We're looking for a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer to develop the algorithms that give the largest drone swarm in the world an accurate, shared picture of the battlespace. This is a deep algorithm role for someone who lives in the details of detection, tracking, and estimation, and wants to see their work fly.

What You'll Do

  • Train, tune, and test automatic target recognition and track management systems using the latest advancements in neural networks.

  • Develop multi-sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multi-target tracking) running onboard resource-constrained vehicles.

  • Design distributed fusion approaches that combine tracks across the swarm into a single coherent picture.

  • Rigorously characterize algorithm performance against real-world flight data and simulation.

  • Optimize models and estimators for real-time inference on edge compute.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

  • Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events.

Basic Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience.

  • Demonstrated expertise in estimation theory and multi-target tracking (Kalman/particle filters, JPDA, MHT, random finite sets, or similar).

  • Hands-on deep learning experience (training, evaluation, and deployment of neural networks for detection or classification).

  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Go, and/or Python.

  • Track record of taking algorithms from research to deployment on a real system.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications or deployed work in ATR, multi-sensor fusion, or distributed estimation.

  • Experience with EO/IR, radar, or RF sensor processing on aerial platforms.

  • Experience deploying ML models to embedded or edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization).

  • Familiarity with defense sensing and tracking problem domains.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Compensation: $180K – $260K • Offers Equity

data.title: MAÎTRE DE CONFÉRENCES dans le domaine du Génie Civil et de la microstructure des matériaux de construction H/F - CDI - IMT Mines Alès
data.description:
Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr.

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil".

En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique.

Activités d'enseignement

  • Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Energie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ;

  • Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du génie civil, des matériaux et du calcul des structures ;

  • Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ;

  • Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ;

  • Piloter une spécialisation en dernière année d’études et proposer des missions de recherche et développement ;

  • Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an.

Activités de recherche

  • Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ;

  • Renforcer la thématique sur les matrices cimentaires bas carbone, en lien avec les propriétés macroscopiques et la durabilité de ces matériaux, et fédérer d’autres chercheurs en faisant le lien avec les aspects modélisation et mécaniques développées au LMGC ;

  • S’intéresser aux méthodes de caractérisation expérimentale des propriétés des matériaux cimentaires de l’état frais et à l’état durci en particulier de la microstructure nécessitant des connaissances en physico-chimie des matrices cimentaires et sur l’adjuvantation ;

  • Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil.

Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique

  • Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ;

  • Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ;

  • Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production.

  • Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques.

Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ici :

https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/Zqr5eBT6ijzic9y


Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des matériaux de construction, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Vous devrez disposer d’une expérience solide en recherche, démontrer votre capacité à développer des collaborations scientifiques, à publier vos travaux et à valoriser les résultats de recherche auprès de partenaires académiques et industriels. La maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique est requise ; une expérience internationale et une capacité à vous intégrer aux projets du LMGC et du C2MA constitueront des atouts.

Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée (Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act.

  • Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées (backdoors) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs.

  • Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles, notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles.

  • Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA.

  • Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé.

  • Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués.

  • Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées.

  • Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche, notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet.

  • Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance,

Activités

  • Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes.

  • Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité, en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites.

  • Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés.

  • Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications.

  • Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré, notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé (Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC).

  • Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information.

  • Étudier l’impact des mécanismes de protection de la vie privée sur les méthodes d’explicabilité, notamment les méthodes fondées sur l’attribution, et identifier des stratégies permettant de préserver leur fidélité.

  • Analyser les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’apprentissage fédéré face aux attaques byzantines et aux attaques par empoisonnement, en particulier lorsque les stratégies adverses exploitent des métriques ou informations issues de l’explicabilité.

  • Étudier des scénarios d’attaque réalistes prenant en compte l’hétérogénéité et le déséquilibre des données détenues par les différents clients, l’empoisonnement des étiquettes (label poisoning) et la présence de clients associés à des attributs protégés.

  • Développer des algorithmes d’agrégation robustes et préservant la vie privée, capables de maintenir les performances du modèle dans des environnements comportant une proportion importante de participants malveillants.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de défense adaptatifs exploitant l’explicabilité, notamment pour identifier les comportements anormaux, les mises à jour suspectes ou les participants potentiellement malveillants.

  • Analyser conjointement les compromis entre vie privée, robustesse, explicabilité et utilité du modèle, en intégrant également les contraintes liées à l’efficacité computationnelle et aux communications.

  • Définir des protocoles et métriques d’évaluation permettant de comparer les approches proposées selon différents niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse, de fidélité des explications et de coût computationnel.

  • Expérimenter et évaluer les méthodes développées sur des scénarios réalistes d’apprentissage décentralisé, notamment dans le domaine de la santé et dans d’autres contextes traitant des données sensibles.

  • Contribuer à la validation expérimentale et à la valorisation des résultats, notamment par la mise en œuvre de prototypes, l’analyse des résultats, la rédaction de publications scientifiques et la présentation des travaux dans des événements scientifiques.


Formation

  • Doctorat ou PhD en informatique depuis moins de 3 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables

  • Expériences en IA ou machine learning (ML) appliquée à la cybersécurité

Capacités et aptitudes

data.title: Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets
data.description:
Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets – Qualification & Validation pour accompagner des projets de transfert entrant de produits en formes sèches et conditionnement.

Intégré au pôle Assurance Qualité Qualification, Validation & Projets, vous serez le représentant de l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble des activités Qualité associées aux projets, depuis la définition de la stratégie de qualification jusqu'à l'exécution des qualifications et au suivi du système qualité.

Vos missions :

  • Représenter l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets et garantir l'application des politiques de qualification pour les nouveaux équipements.
  • Définir et rédiger la documentation Qualité associée aux projets, notamment les besoins utilisateurs, cahiers des charges, plans directeurs de validation et rapports associés.
  • Piloter le système qualité à l'échelle des projets : Change Controls, CAPA, déviations et gestion documentaire.
  • Réaliser les analyses de criticité et analyses de risques relatives aux équipements et systèmes mis en place.
  • Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP, selon les besoins des projets.
  • Participer à l'exécution des qualifications sur le terrain, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Utilisateurs et Ingénierie.
  • Revoir et contribuer à la rédaction des procédures, modes opératoires et autres documents Qualité nécessaires à la mise en exploitation.
  • Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
  • Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets.
  • Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations.

Requirements

Chez Excelya, nous recherchons avant tout des professionnels rigoureux, autonomes et capables de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.

  • Expérience : Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en Assurance Qualité et Qualification/Validation dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
  • Expertise procédés : Vous possédez idéalement une expérience dans les procédés de formes sèches, notamment en extrusion, granulation sur LAF, compression et/ou conditionnement.
  • Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés.
  • Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP.
  • Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA, de l'Annexe 15 des EU GMP, du 21 CFR Part 11, des principes GAMP 5, ICH Q9 et ALCOA+.
  • Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent.
  • Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet.
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum, permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, permet à nos collaborateurs de développer leurs expertises aux côtés d'acteurs majeurs des Life Sciences.

En rejoignant cette mission, vous participerez directement à des projets de transferts de produits pharmaceutiques, avec un rôle central dans la maîtrise de la qualité, la qualification des équipements et la préparation des installations à leur exploitation.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez un Excelyate !

data.description:
AMI cherche un.e nouvel.le ambassadeur.drice BARISTA pour rejoindre notre Flagship du Marais.

Chez AMI, nous avons à cœur de créer une expérience client à la fois chaleureuse, authentique et exigeante, à l’image de notre Maison.

Sous la responsabilité du Store Manager, vous contribuez à offrir une expérience accueillante et qualitative à nos clients à travers la préparation et le service des boissons, tout en veillant à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement de l’espace Café de la boutique.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

 

Accueil et relation client

  • Accueillir chaque client, conseiller sur la carte, créer une expérience à la hauteur de l'image de la Maison

  • Assurer la fluidité du service en période d'affluence

  • Faire le lien avec les équipes de la boutique : le Café et le Retail partagent le même espace et la même clientèle

Préparation des boissons

  • Extraction espresso, boissons lactées et latte art.

  • Création de recettes d'espresso et de filtre pour chaque nouveau café.

  • Réglages quotidiens du moulin et de la machine, contrôle de la constance tout au long du service

  • Dégustation et ajustement des recettes, participation aux évolutions de la carte

Gestion des stocks et des achats

  • Suivi des niveaux de stock (café, lait, consommables, packaging)

  • Passage des commandes fournisseurs et relation directe avec eux (torréfacteur, grossistes, consommables)

  • Réception et contrôle des livraisons, gestion des DLC, limitation des pertes

  • Inventaires réguliers et remontée des écarts

Gestion du matériel

  • Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste

  • Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens

  • Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives

  • Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste

Encadrement

  • Encadrer et former le second barista : gestes techniques, standards de service, montée en compétence

  • Organiser les plannings du binôme et la répartition des tâches

  • Participer aux recrutements à venir : définition du besoin, entretiens, intégration des nouveaux arrivants


  • Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum)

    -Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art

    -Autonomie démontrée sur les stocks et la relation fournisseurs

    -À l'aise avec l'entretien et la maintenance courante du matériel

    -Connaissance de la filière café de spécialité (torréfacteurs, sourcing, tendances)

  • Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet.

  • Vous êtes souriant.e, dynamique, impliqué.e et doté.e d'excellentes qualités relationnelles.

  • Vous avez un sens développé du service client et avez à cœur de satisfaire les besoins de la clientèle.

  • Vous avez une forte sensibilité pour la Mode et à l'univers de la marque

  • La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable.

  • Date de démarrage : 15 novembre.

Why join the « F.ami.LY »?

Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair.

Rejoignez une Maison de mode en pleine croissance, engagée et bienveillante, où chacun peut apporter sa personnalité et contribuer à une aventure collective.

Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe.

Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will be the voice and face of global brands for Japanese-speaking customers across Europe:

  • Be the Problem Solver: Assist customers via phone, live chat, and/or email with inquiries regarding products, order tracking, bookings, or account support.
  • Deliver Top-Class Service: Turn tricky situations into positive customer moments through clear, empathetic, and friendly communication.
  • Troubleshoot & Guide: Walk users through basic technical issues, service setups, or account features step-by-step.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work side-by-side with international colleagues in an inspiring, multicultural environment.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest brand features, tools, and updates with ongoing support.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Japanese: Native or fluent (C1/C2 level) in both written and spoken communication.
  • Good English Knowledge: (B2 level or higher) to navigate company systems and communicate with international team members.
  • Work Eligibility: EU Passport or a valid legal work permit for Greece.
  • Age Requirement: At least 18 years old.
  • Digital Literacy: Comfortable navigating computers, multi-screen environments, and basic software applications.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication skills, active listening, empathy, and a positive problem-solving mindset.
  • Relocation Readiness: Willingness and motivation to relocate to Greece in the coming weeks.

Benefits

  • 14 Salaries per Year: In Greece, you receive extra salary bonuses for Easter, Summer, and Christmas!
  • Monthly Performance Bonuses: Extra financial rewards based on your achievements and team KPIs.
  • Full Relocation Support:
    • Flight tickets booked to Greece
    • Complimentary hotel or apartment stay upon arrival
    • Dedicated assistance with local paperwork (AFM tax number, social security, bank accounts)
    • Real estate guidance to help you find your permanent apartment in Athens
  • Paid Professional Training: Comprehensive onboarding program to get you fully confident before taking your first customer inquiry.
  • Career Progression: Clear growth paths into Quality Assurance, Team Leadership, Training, or Operations within major global companies.
  • Mediterranean Lifestyle: Over 300 days of sunshine a year, vibrant city life, world-famous cuisine, and incredible beaches right on your doorstep.

A Recruitment Process Built Around Your Profile

We know moving to another country is a big decision, so we make the journey smooth and completely transparent:

  1. Application: Submit your CV in English or Japanese.
  2. Personal Consultation: A friendly 1-on-1 interview with the recruitment team at Next Job Abroad to discuss your experience, interests, and preferred project types.
  3. Profile Matching: We match your background with current active openings in Greece and present you directly to the best-fit opportunity.
  4. Guidance & Placement: We guide you through the client interview, offer confirmation, relocation logistics, and onboarding—every single step of the way!

Why Athens, Greece?

Athens seamlessly blends rich ancient history with a buzzing, modern lifestyle. Enjoy low living costs relative to Western Europe, an unbeatable café culture, vibrant nightlife, and quick weekend ferry rides to islands like Aegina, Hydra, and Mykonos.

Ready to start your Greek adventure?

data.title: Content Editor
data.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you.

What you will work on

  • Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text;

  • Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product;

  • Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases;

  • Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links;

  • Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak;

  • Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar;

  • Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series;

  • Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish.

Your must haves

  • English as your native language;

  • A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it;

  • An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't;

  • The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer;

  • An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen;

  • Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up.

Nice to have

  • Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product;

  • Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice;

  • Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use;

The deal

  • Competitive salary in USD;

  • Fully remote position;

  • Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally;

  • Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential.
